Create a New Sideview Canvas State Object

Source: R/state.R
new_sideview_state.Rd

Constructs a structured sideview_state object containing canvas transform, card configurations, table join connections, and pipeline script state.

Usage

new_sideview_state(
  version = "0.3.0",
  canvas = list(zoom = 1, pan_x = 0, pan_y = 0),
  cards = list(),
  connections = list(),
  pipeline = list(code = "", active_tab = "pipeline")
)

Arguments

version

Character string representing state schema version (default "0.3.0").

canvas

Named list containing canvas settings: zoom (numeric), pan_x (numeric), pan_y (numeric).

cards

List of card state objects (each specifying id, name, x, y, width, height, minimized, sorts and filters; a sort is list(col, dir) with dir "asc" or "desc", a filter is list(col, op, val)).

connections

List of join connection objects (each specifying from_table, from_col, to_table, to_col, join_type).

pipeline

Named list containing code (character), active_tab (character) and, from version 0.3.0, the pipeline steps and pipe ("%>%" or "|>"). Without steps, code is restored as one custom step.

Value

An object of class c("sideview_state", "list").

Details

The canvas writes this shape when you click Save in the toolbar, and sideview(..., state = ) / sideview_widget(..., state = ) restore it. Cards are matched to tables by name.

Examples

st <- new_sideview_state()
print(st)
#> <sideview_state v0.3.0>
#>   Cards:       0
#>   Connections: 0
#>   Canvas:      zoom = 1, pan = (0, 0)
#>   Active Tab:  pipeline
